I've rebooked all 8 passengers from the cancelled ZX 400 (FRA → JFK). Everyone kept their cabin, and each booking reference is together on one flight:

| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja and Luka Horvat | Economy | **ZX 404**, 2026-11-03 07:00 |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | **ZX 406**, 2026-11-03 10:00 |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | **ZX 402**, 2026-11-02 18:00 |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | **ZX 402**, 2026-11-02 18:00 |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | **ZX 402**, 2026-11-02 18:00 |

- **Horvats:** ZX 402 is the earliest flight but had only 2 free economy seats, so the three of them went on ZX 404.
- **Rossis:** ZX 402 had only 1 free business seat and ZX 404 had none, so they went on ZX 406.
- **Single travellers:** The three single-passenger bookings all fit on the earliest flight, ZX 402. That takes ZX 402's last 2 economy seats and its last business seat.

The app confirmed each rebooking, and ZX 400 now shows no passengers.
